messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected for /v1/generate (us-east-1, model: redwood-xl-1). p95=420ms (SLO=200ms), p99=2.1s (SLO=500ms). Streaming stalls observed (streaming stall count +420 in last 5m). Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1765123456
Samir Patel: acked. i'm on it — paging oncall. can someone paste the p50/p95/p99 table by route?
Liam O'Neill: quick snapshot from latency dashboard: 
```
route            p50   p95   p99   stalls/min
/v1/generate     120ms 420ms 2.1s  84
/v1/chat         95ms  200ms 750ms  6
/embeddings      30ms  70ms  130ms  0
```
Maria Chen: seeing correlated spike with increased kv-cache misses. cache hitrate went from ~98% -> ~26% after a config push 4m ago. checking rollout.
Samir Patel: any deploys 4-5m ago? deploy-bot, show last deploys to serving-us-east-1.
deploy-bot: deploys: 1765123330 - rollout/redwood-xl-1-quant-opt (canary 10% -> 100% at 1765123345).
Maria Chen: that canary just finished. looks like the quant-opt variant has different KV cache keying (bug?).
Liam O'Neill: observability: redis (prefix-kv) latency increased from 3ms->120ms and error rate jumped. KV eviction rate up 8x. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/metrics/kv/redis-us-east-1
Anya Kuznetsova: support: 3 customers pinged via health webhooks about streaming stalls (IDs: C-4332, C-4401, C-4499). pushing incident banner now.
Samir Patel: immediate mitigation plan: 1) rollback canary -> previous model 2) enable fallback routing to smaller model for streaming routes 3) throttle new sessions to reduce burst. Maria, can you start rollback?
Maria Chen: rolling back canary now. running: 
```
rwctl rollout cancel rollout/redwood-xl-1-quant-opt --region us-east-1
kubectl -n serving rollout restart deployment/serving-router-us-east-1
```
Maria Chen: also bumping autoscaler min pods +2 as precaution: `kubectl scale --replicas=8 deployment/serving-worker-us-east-1`
Liam O'Neill: added routing rule to divert 30% traffic from /v1/generate -> redwood-l1-fallback for lower latency. command: `rwctl traffic-shift --from redwood-xl-1 --to redwood-l1-fallback --percent 30`
Samir Patel: checking downstream queues and GPU util — GPU util is ~95% on a subset of nodes running quant-opt; memory pressure high. good call on diverting.
Maria Chen: rollback complete at 1765123578. can confirm p95 dropped to ~180ms. p99 still ~640ms but trending down.
Liam O'Neill: KV cache warm-up needed — hitrate at 38% now after rollback. considering issuing a cache-warm job for top 100 prefixes.
Samir Patel: agree. Maria, schedule warm-up job and set a temporary cache TTL extension to prevent immediate evictions.
Maria Chen: warm-up job kicked: `jobs/cache-warm --prefixes-file top100.txt --region us-east-1`
Anya Kuznetsova: notified affected customers with ETA: partial mitigation in place, ongoing recovery. asking legal/CS for any escalations.
Samir Patel: monitoring. Please watch p99 and streaming stalls for next 30m. I'll stay on until 1765123710 then hand off. Liam, you'll take over after that.
Liam O'Neill: taking handoff. I'll post a 5m cadence update. switching zoom.
incident-bot: update: alert resolved? firing threshold cleared for p95/p99 at 1765123690. p95=185ms, p99=490ms, stalls/min=6.
Samir Patel: thanks team. follow-ups: 1) postmortem to include deploy gating for cache key schema changes 2) automated pre-checks for cache-key compatibility 3) quicker rollback runbook. assigning owners in #postmortems.
Maria Chen: adding logs to the thread: sample error from redis: `ERR invalid key for prefix` and stack trace shows model-quant branch changed key prefix.
Liam O'Neill: will update dashboards to show kv-hitrate overlay on latency charts.
Anya Kuznetsova: logging CS notes and customer impact timeline.
Samir Patel: i'm handing off to Liam at 1765123710. leaving open for 1hr for verification. if anything regresses, page immediately. :thumbsup:
Liam O'Neill: copy that. I'll file a short incident summary and tag infra/serving for root-cause.
Maria Chen: thanks all — great coordinated response.
